negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 25644760 - the midodrine + octreotide regimen was inferior to terlipressin + albumin in hepatorenal syndrome.
PMID 34793718 and PMID 38851203 both use high-dose octreotide as the comparator arm that 177Lu-Dotatate beats; octreotide is the control that loses in modern NET trials.
PMID 9127169 (acute pancreatitis) is an indication where octreotide has been tested and is not standard - check the direction of the result before citing.
cautions: Octreotide appears in dozens of trials as a background or control therapy rather than the compound under test. Do not present a control-arm result as evidence of octreotide efficacy.
CAM2029 (subcutaneous depot) and Mycapssa (oral) are distinct formulations - do not merge their trial results with Sandostatin LAR.
